hypothesis: Own-axis zonal concentration in a deep ReLU network INCREASES with harmonic degree, so that the CUMULATIVE own-axis capture across the measured high-degree band clears the materiality bar that a single degree could not. deg6_own_axis_zonal_capture_v1 measured degree six alone and killed on materiality: own-axis capture of the depth-thirty-two readout was 0.001872 of the degree-three-and-above residual, 10.2 times the matched random floor but a tenth of the predeclared two-percent bar, with a depth ladder decaying from 0.16 at the entry layer to 0.002 at the readout. The follow-on premise is a DEGREE BAND rather than a degree. The claim under test is that at degrees eight, twelve, sixteen, twenty-four and forty-eight the per-neuron kink tails progressively dominate the cross-axis mixing background, so that the summed own-axis capture over the gated rungs reaches two percent of the degree-three-and-above residual and a multi-degree theorem-fixed-coefficient control becomes constructible. If the degree profile is flat or decreasing, the high-degree door closes with a measured surface rather than an argument, and v1's KILL is CONFIRMED on the wider premise instead of superseded.
causal_mechanism: The generator is the rectifier's kink. relu(w.u) depends on u only through the cosine with its own normalized weight row, so its ENTIRE harmonic tail is exactly zonal about that row, and the tail decays only polynomially because the kink is a point of non-smoothness: the exact own-axis coefficient at degree n is lambda_n = sqrt(N(d,n)) times half the alternating sum of the normalized Gegenbauer coefficients against the exact absolute moments, computed here in exact rational arithmetic, giving 0.0027737, -0.0018494, -0.0010644, -0.00072504, -0.00042447, -0.00017003 at degrees 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 48. The competing background is cross-axis mixing: the higher Hermite channels of every deeper rectifier build degree-n content out of PRODUCTS of zonal functions about different axes, and such products leave every single-axis zonal span. The hypothesis is that the product background, being assembled from smoother low-degree factors, decays FASTER in n than the kink tail, so the own-axis SHARE rises with degree even as both fall. The measurement decides it by reading the two profiles against each other on a single (degree x depth) surface. Two exactly-known quantities calibrate that surface at every rung: the entry-layer activation, whose own-axis capture is exactly lambda_n squared times the row norm squared, and the second-layer preactivation, which is a linear combination of entry-layer ridge functions and therefore lies EXACTLY inside the entry-layer zonal span with captured degree-n energy lambda_n squared times a^T G a for the known coefficient vector a. Under the addition-theorem normalization the zonal about an axis scaled by the square root of the degree-n dimension has unit norm and inner product equal to the normalized Gegenbauer of the axis-axis cosine, so captured energies are comparable across axis sets of equal count; and because distinct harmonic degrees are exactly orthogonal, per-degree captures expressed against the SAME degree-three-and-above denominator ADD, which is what makes a cumulative metric well defined rather than a convention.
cheapest_falsifier: Run three seeded synthetic depth-thirty-two width-256 He networks. For each, form the own-axis pool (the normalized first-layer weight rows plus the top eight eigenvectors of the tangential input-gradient second moment, estimated on an independent pilot sample) and six matched-count pools of uniform random axes. On two independent Monte-Carlo halves of 327680 samples each, run ONE Gegenbauer recurrence per sample-by-axis tile and harvest the addition-theorem-normalized zonal coefficients at degrees 6, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 48 from that single pass, so all six degrees ride the identical forward passes and the identical axis pools. Form the split-half cross product through each pool's exact Gram at each degree. Express every captured energy as a fraction of the same network's degree-three-and-above residual energy. Admit a rung to the metric only on measured power: its readout noise, its recovery of the EXACT second-layer in-span energy, and its reach of the exactly-known unit second moment of its own feature. Sum the own-axis captures and the random floors over the admitted rungs. If the summed own-axis fraction fails to reach four times the larger of the summed measured floor and the predeclared materiality bar, the degree-band door closes with a measured surface and the degree-six KILL is confirmed on the wider premise.
equal_budget_baseline: Six matched-count random axis pools (264 uniform directions each) measured at EVERY degree on the IDENTICAL Monte-Carlo samples with the IDENTICAL estimator and the identical exact Gram solve -- across arms the only difference is where the axes come from, and across rungs the only difference is which degree is harvested from the shared recurrence. Their per-degree maximum is that degree's floor; their spread across the eighteen pool-by-seed draws per degree is the in-run noise measurement, reported per degree as a standard deviation and as a resolvable-at-three-sigma number. Three exact positive controls ride the same pipeline at every rung: the entry-layer activation coefficient against the closed-form lambda_n, the second-layer preactivation captured energy against its closed-form in-span value, and the zonal feature's own second moment against its exact value of one. A matched isotropic-null active-subspace spectrum built from the same number of iid Gaussian vectors controls the pullback-concentration claim, and the raw-gradient ridge-collinearity spectrum has the exact value one at layer one as its anchor.
predicted_signature: SMOKE-INFORMED (off-protocol base seed 778001312, disclosed in full: the designer ran the shipped smoke config, a standalone feature-reach sweep to 6.1e8 axis-sample draws, a tile-size benchmark, and ONE single-seed probe at v1's production sample count with production pilot sizes; production seeds 20260904-20260906 never run before sealing). The metric lands in the KILL region with probability about 0.93, driven by the MATERIALITY leg alone while the STRUCTURAL leg passes -- the same split v1 produced, now on the wider premise, and that split is the informative outcome. THE DEGREE PROFILE IS PREDICTED TO FALL, NOT RISE. Designer single-seed probe at m_half 131072: readout own-axis capture 0.003453, 0.001549, 0.000645, 0.000473, 0.000029, -0.000008 at degrees 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 48, i.e. ratios to degree six of 1, 0.449, 0.187, 0.137, 0.008, -0.002 against the EXACT entry-layer kink-tail profile lambda_n squared over lambda_6 squared of 1, 0.4446, 0.1473, 0.0683, 0.0234, 0.0038. The deep readout's own-axis capture therefore decays with degree at very nearly the exact entry-layer kink-tail rate, slightly flatter at twelve and sixteen: the surviving own-axis content is the entry-layer kink tail transported forward, and it does not gain share with degree. Expected gated set {6, 8, 12, 16}; expected summed own-axis capture 0.003 to 0.007, against the 0.0267 that escaping KILL requires, so the material leg clips at 2.0 and the structural leg lands near 0.03 to 0.10. POWER, PREDECLARED SO IT IS NOT READ AS A DEFECT: the zonal feature's exactly-unit second moment is only partly reached at high degree, measured at 0.996, 0.949, 0.624, 0.560, 0.447, 0.340 for degrees 6 to 48 at m_half 131072, and a standalone sweep found the degree-24 and degree-48 values PLATEAU near 0.49 and 0.41 between 2.6e8 and 6.1e8 draws rather than climbing, so degree 48 is expected REPORTED-NOT-GATED on reach and on span recovery (probe span ratios about 1.9 to 2.0 against the admissible band [0.5, 2.0]), and degree 24 is a genuine coin flip sitting within a few hundredths of the 0.5 reach bar. Its inclusion or exclusion moves the summed own capture by under 0.0001 and cannot change the disposition. Instruments at probe scale read clean: second-layer exact-span recovery 0.99, 0.97, 1.01, 1.03, 0.99 at degrees 6 through 24; Gram diagonal error 6.4e-14; worst Gram condition 1.005 at degree six falling to exactly 1.0 at degrees 16 and above, because the zonal features about different axes become orthonormal as the degree grows; no pinv fallback; own-pool worst off-diagonal cosine about 0.39, far inside the degree-48 oscillatory region boundary of 2 sqrt(48)/sqrt(256) = 0.87 where the forward recurrence is stable. Ridge collinearity reads top-one gradient share EXACTLY 1.000000 at layer one, 0.51 at layer two, 0.22 at layer four, 0.075 at layer eight and 0.038 at the readout against an isotropic null of 0.011. Pullback concentration replicates against its isotropic null. Band (0.25, 0.75) about 0.05; PASS at or below 0.25 about 0.02. Recognizable failure of the prediction: summed own-axis capture at or above 0.0267 over the gated rungs, or, softer and equally interesting, a readout profile ratio rho_own(12)/rho_own(6) above 1.0 -- a genuinely RISING degree profile, which is the mechanism the hypothesis asserts and which the probe did not see.
second_signal: Five, in-run, each able to fail independently of the metric. (a) EXACT COEFFICIENT CHECK PER DEGREE: relu(t) = (t + |t|)/2 and the linear part is orthogonal to every zonal of degree above one, so the entry-layer own-axis coefficient equals the row norm times lambda_n, and lambda_n is computed here in EXACT rational arithmetic from the exact Gegenbauer coefficients and the exact absolute moments, never by a cancelling float sum; lambda_6 reproduces v1's authenticated constant 0.00277366 through an independent code path, which is asserted at import. (b) EXACT SPAN ENERGY CHECK PER DEGREE: the second-layer preactivation lies exactly in the entry-layer zonal span, so its captured degree-n energy has the closed form lambda_n squared times a^T G a; this exercises the WHOLE pipeline -- recurrence, normalization, Gram solve and split-half estimator -- against a known number at every rung, and it is one of the three power-gate legs. Cross-checked before sealing against v1's authenticated report: the closed form predicts 3.05e-5 for the degree-six second-layer captured energy where v1 measured 2.9e-5. (c) NUMERICAL EXACTNESS AT DEGREE 48: the shipped float64 recurrence is compared at import against evaluation of the same polynomial in exact rational arithmetic at ten cosines spanning zero to one, giving a worst relative error of 1.9e-15 at degree 48 and 2.1e-16 at degree 6, with P_n(1) = 1 to 3e-16 at every rung; both are asserted, so numerical regression becomes a protocol kill. (d) FLOOR, SPREAD AND REACH PER DEGREE: eighteen matched random pool draws per degree give the floor, its standard deviation and the resolvable effect at three standard deviations, and the feature's exactly-unit second moment gives the share of its own variance the sample count actually reaches, so the power of every rung is reported rather than assumed and rungs without it are reported-not-gated. (e) RIDGE COLLINEARITY: the raw input-gradient second-moment spectrum of every ladder target, which for a function exactly zonal about one axis has top-one share EXACTLY 1 -- a hard anchor at layer one -- and whose decay with depth measures, with no harmonic machinery involved at all, how far the deep kink surfaces have bent away from great spheres about any fixed input-space axis.
inconclusive_band_note: The metric is the LARGER of two requirements divided by the summed own-axis capture, so it reports whichever leg binds; the runner emits both legs separately (leg_structural_floor_over_own, leg_material_bar_over_own) and the judge MUST copy the leg split into the disposition record, exactly as v1 required, because the ledger's single stored metric cannot say which leg bound. The judge MUST ALSO copy cumulative.gated_rungs and cumulative.reported_not_gated_rungs, because the metric is defined over the admitted rungs only and a disposition that does not name them is not interpretable. The band (0.25, 0.75) means the own-axis band captures between 1.33 and 4 times the binding requirement -- above the noise but short of a construction warrant; in the band the disposition is an owner call with the measured surface attached. Two degenerate outcomes are NOT kills and must not be recorded as such: if the degree-six anchor rung fails its gate the run is an INSTRUMENT FAILURE, since v1 resolved that rung at 10.2 times its floor on 2.5 times fewer samples, and the runner flags this at top level as instrument_failure_not_a_kill; and if no rung is admitted at all the metric is emitted at 2.0 with the same flag set, which is a statement about power, not about the hypothesis. The materiality bar stays at 0.02 for the SUM rather than being divided among the rungs, which is the declared premise change and makes v2 strictly easier to pass than v1 on the material leg; a v2 KILL therefore confirms v1 a fortiori, while a v2 PASS supersedes it only on the declared band premise. Because the k32 death law forbids fitted coefficients, captured energy remains an UPPER bound on what a lawful control could remove, and a PASS authorizes only a separately frozen multi-degree construction stage, never a control.

(2) m191_harmonic_cv_g0b fitted split-sample coefficients for a FIXED 24-function basis from pooled singular vectors and measured regression gain against cached truth; this cell fits NOTHING, uses the network-ADAPTIVE per-neuron zonal basis at six degrees that m191 never formed, and measures projected energy. (3) m107_spherical_gegenbauer_exact_zero_controls, the closest relative: built exact-zero Gegenbauer controls over first-layer axes and died on HELD coefficient-transport ratios after favorable training ratios -- the k32 law, not absent zonal energy; its training-side ratios are weak evidence FOR this premise, and its death is the reason a PASS here leads only to a theorem-fixed construction stage. (4) k32_base_sensitivity's death law (theorem-fixed coefficients only) is the reason this cell exists; lambda_n is exactly such a theorem-fixed coefficient and is computed here in exact rational arithmetic at every rung. WHY HIGHER DEGREES WERE EXPECTED TO DIFFER, stated as the mechanism and as the thing being tested: ReLU's kink is a point of non-smoothness, so each entry-layer neuron's harmonic tail decays only polynomially and is EXACTLY zonal about its own axis at every degree, whereas the cross-axis mixing background is assembled from products of smoother low-degree factors and was expected to decay faster in n; the own-axis share should then rise with degree. The designer's own probe contradicts this at the degrees that can be measured, which is why the cell is worth running and why the predicted signature is a KILL. TRANSFER LOGIC AND ITS LIMIT, declared: no truth machinery exists in a dev-only cell, so the measured object is the network function, not the estimator residual; the design integrates degrees zero through two exactly, so the residual inherits the function's high-degree components to first order -- a KILL transfers a fortiori, a PASS would require a follow-on stage with truth. WHY NO ABSOLUTE PER-DEGREE FRACTION: the degree-n projection kernel has variance of order the degree-n dimension, which runs from 4.14e11 at degree six to 1.98e56 at degree 48, unestimable at any budget; the reported currency (captured over degree-three-and-above residual) is exactly the R^2 a control on those axes could achieve, is directly comparable to m191 and to v1, and adds across degrees because distinct harmonic degrees are orthogonal. THE COST OF THAT CHOICE, disclosed: a flat or falling degree profile cannot by itself separate 'the degree-n energy is not own-axis' from 'there is little degree-n energy left to capture', and the design answers this only indirectly, through the exact entry-layer kink-tail profile lambda_n squared as the reference curve and through the ridge-collinearity spectrum as an independent geometric measurement.
